APPENDIX 22  Laboratory Values for Nutritional Assessment and Monitoring
Ferritin
The primary intracellular Fe- 
storage protein; stored mostly in 
liver; serum levels parallel iron 
stores;
Best biochemical index of uncompli-
cated iron deficiency or overload 
(iron toxicity) and excess storage.
Rule out hemochromatosis or pan-
creatitis if Ferritin .1000 ng/dL 
(.1000 mcg/L).

.400 ng/mL
